=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~5007-5009 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The updated grep can match a later issue keyword anywhere in the PR body and extract that tracking number instead of the intended first reference.
  WHY: A body containing “See also: closes #999” before “Refs #123” would set _orch_body_tracking_num=999 even when the head-ref tracking number is 123, causing a false-positive mismatch warning.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~5007 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: Changing the grep to case-insensitive alters the observable behavior for PRs and downstream tooling that depended on exact-match semantics.
  WHY: Previously only uppercase keywords matched the diagnostic cross-check; now lowercase keywords also trigger the warning, which is intentional alignment with GitHub’s parsing but still a behavior change.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~2169-2228 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The helper passes `${default_branch}` and `${integration_branch}` unchecked into the URL path of the compare API call.
  WHY: Branch names with `/` or other crafted values can produce an unintended compare path or API response, so the compare endpoint should use the ref namespace consistently.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~2189-2228 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: There is a TOCTOU race between the `integration_branch_exists` probe and the later compare API call.
  WHY: The branch can disappear after the existence check and before compare, causing a fail-closed 404/422 path; this is safe but still a real race.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~9388-9403 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new `CWS_AHEAD_BY` block adds one compare API call per orchestrator poll tick when an integration branch exists.
  WHY: This increases per-cycle API usage on active branches, even though the short-circuit paths avoid the call in several cases.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:cmd_check_wave_status (~2398-2432 and ~2579-2599) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new JSON fields `integration_ahead_by` and `integration_contained_in_default` are emitted unconditionally.
  WHY: Older callers that validate a strict schema or do not ignore unknown sibling keys may break because the output shape changed.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~2169-2228 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The helper passes `${default_branch}` and `${integration_branch}` unchecked into the URL path of the compare API call.
  WHY: If a branch name contains `/` or other crafted values, the compare path can be malformed or resolve unexpectedly, so the helper should validate or namespace refs more strictly.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:lines ~5007-5009 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The updated body tracking-number extraction can match a later issue keyword anywhere in the PR body and may set _orch_body_tracking_num to an unintended issue number.
  WHY: If the PR body says “Fixes #123” in the first line and later says “See also: closes #999”, the cross-check can warn on `#999` even though the head-ref tracking number is `123`, adding noise to operational logs.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~2189-2228 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: There is a TOCTOU race between `integration_branch_exists "${integration_branch}"` and the subsequent compare API call.
  WHY: A concurrent branch deletion can happen after the existence probe succeeds but before compare completes, and the helper then fails closed with a compare error instead of silently accepting stale state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~9388-9403 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The new `CWS_AHEAD_BY` block adds one compare API call per orchestrator poll tick when an integration branch exists.
  WHY: Active integration branches that are contained in default still issue a compare call every cycle, which increases API budget consumption even though the current call site only invokes it once per tick.

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~5007 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `grep -oiE '(refs|closes|fixes|resolves)[[:space:]]*#[0-9]+' | head -n1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+'` can extract a later reference when multiple issue keywords exist in the PR body.
  WHY: A body containing both the primary reference and a later “See also: closes #999” can produce `_orch_body_tracking_num=999`, triggering a spurious mismatch warning even when the head-ref pattern matches the correct tracking number.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~2189-2210 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: There is a TOCTOU race between the `integration_branch_exists` probe and the later compare API call.
  WHY: The branch can vanish between the probe and compare, but the deleted-branch short-circuit plus fail-closed compare path makes the race benign rather than a correctness failure.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~9388-9403 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `_integration_branch_ahead_of_default` is called on every poll tick for any active integration branch.
  WHY: The gate adds a measurable per-cycle API increment without per-cycle caching, even though short-circuits avoid the call in empty/equal/deleted cases.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:cmd_check_wave_status (~2398-2432 and ~2579-2599) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: New JSON fields `integration_ahead_by` and `integration_contained_in_default` are emitted unconditionally.
  WHY: Older callers that perform strict JSON schema validation or that do not ignore unknown sibling keys will break because the output shape changed.
